Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human histone deacetylase 6. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name for human histone deacetylase 6. Require structures via INNER JOIN compound_structures on molregno. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
